title: Weekday Focus Sprint Journal — Sprint 12
body:
Sprint window: Mon 2026-03-09 — Fri 2026-03-13
Context: trying an explicit weekday-only focused sprint to protect evenings/weekends and push two personal OKR threads: 1) measurable deep work improvement, 2) delivery of two small infra perf experiments that can feed Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Signals I'm tracking this sprint (personal KPI lens):
- Deep work minutes (calendar focus blocks w/o Slack): target 16h/week. Current: 9h (Mon-Wed).
- Experiment velocity: target 2 experiments merged. Current: 0 merged, 1 PR open (PR #567).
- Quality signal: test flake rate on local perf harness < 5%. Current: 8% (needs triage).
- Energy consistency: sleep 7h/night target; tracked via Fitband. This week avg: 6.4h.
- Mentorship: 1x pair session with intern per week. Completed: 1 (Tue).

Sprint commitments (my promises to self):
- Ship cache-warm experiment (small change to prefetch seeds) and gather 2-day cost delta. (JIRA INFR-342).
- Close PR feedback loop on PR #567 by Wed EOD and coordinate perf run with SRE.
- Block out 4x 90-minute deep work blocks (Mon-Thu) and track interruptions.
- Draft 1-pager for manager on how we measure signal drift for model rollout quality.

Daily log (short):
- Mon: good focus AM; started cache-warm prototype; interrupted by ops pager (30m). Logged baseline perf numbers; noticed 99p latency spike for chat-route when qlen>512. Action: add instrumentation.
- Tue: pair session with intern on profiling tools — high value. Opened PR #567 (benchmark harness changes). Evening energy low; canceled one scheduled deep block.
- Wed: ran smoke perf job; observed test flake sources in harness due to docker image race. Filed small bug (INFR-349). Spent sprint afternoon triaging flakes (regressive but important).

Retrospective notes (what worked / what didn't):
- Wins:
  - Pairing with the intern accelerated understanding of the profiling harness; we identified a missing warmup pass.
  - Kept evenings protected (no work Slack after 6pm) — mental benefit noticeable.
- Pain points:
  - Unexpected ops pager consumed prime deep-work time Monday. Need a plan to route non-critical alerts to on-call reserve.
  - PR feedback for #567 had two separate threads (perf and style) which fragmented review. Next time: separate perf-only PRs to reduce churn.

Action items (concrete, ownership, timeline):
- Sienna: isolate the cache-warm prototype into feature branch and run 48h A/B cost job (by Mon 2026-03-16).
- Sienna + SRE (Noah): add higher-resolution tracing on chat-route 99p to capture qlen>512 path (by Fri 2026-03-13).
- Sienna: split PR #567 into two (bench harness + refactor); request focused reviewers for each (by Thu 2026-03-12).
- Team: propose “pager-lite” policy for low-priority alerts to reduce interruptions (draft doc by Tue 2026-03-17) — tagging Asha to lead with me.

Hypotheses to test next sprint (linked to OKRs):
- H1: A dedicated warmup pass (2–3 tokens of synthetic prompts) will reduce 99p latency on chat-route by 12–20% for sequences >512. Metric: change in 99p latency and cost-per-token.
- H2: Two uninterrupted 90-minute blocks per day increase measurable deliverable throughput (PRs merged/week) by 30%. Metric: merged PR count and deep minutes correlation.

Notes to self / questions to resolve:
- How noisy is the 99p signal across regions? Need to roll perf run in us-west and eu-central.
- Can we get a quick dashboard for per-route flake rates? Current dashboard is team-level and hides micro-spikes. JIRA follow-up: INFR-351.
- Is the intern assignment reusable across other profiling tasks — make a small onboarding checklist.

Quick wins for next 48 hours:
- Rebase PR #567 and split perf vs refactor. (small, if I prioritize it Thu morning).
- Add a single high-cardinality tag to the perf harness logs to isolate docker-image races.

Mood & meta: feeling disciplined but slightly fatigued; keeping evenings sacrosanct helped. Will experiment with limiting Slack checks to two 15-min windows/day next sprint.

Reference snippets (copy-pasteable):
- JIRA: INFR-342 - cache warmup experiment (owner: Sienna)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/567 - benchmark harness change
- Bug: INFR-349 - docker image race in perf harness

End-of-sprint micro-retro: 3 things to celebrate / 3 things to improve
- Celebrate: 1) Clearer instrumentation plan; 2) Intern pair session; 3) Evenings stayed free.
- Improve: 1) Reduce pager interruptions (process); 2) Decrease test flake rate; 3) Be more aggressive about PR scoping (split earlier).

Next checkpoint: Monday 2026-03-16 morning — quick check (15m) to confirm A/B job started and PR split.

-- Sienna
